title: FAQ: Where is GSFC University located?
content:
Question: Where is GSFC University located?
Answer: GSFC University is located in the green campus of Fertilizernagar, Vadodara (Pin: 391 750). GSFC's 22 plants are within one kilometre, which keeps the university close to industry and exposes students to workplace environments.

title: FAQ: Legal status and UGC recognition
content:
Question: Legal status and UGC recognition
Answer: GSFC University was established under the Gujarat Private Universities Act, 2009 (Second Amendment 2014) and notified on 19 December 2014. It is a recognized private university listed under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act and can award degrees, diplomas and certificates. It started with 214 students and has grown to over 3,300 students. Graduates are eligible for UPSC, CAT, GATE and other opportunities across India.

title: FAQ: What programs are offered at GSFC University?
content:
Question: What programs are offered at GSFC University?
Answer: The university offers undergraduate, postgraduate and research programs: B.Tech, BCA, M.Tech, Ph.D and PG Diploma in Industrial Safety (technology programs); B.Sc./B.Sc. (Hons.), M.Sc. and Ph.D (science programs); and BBA, B.Com, MBA and Ph.D in Management (management programs). The university website currently groups them into five schools: SoICT, SoCEFS, SoCIS, SoLS and SoM&E.

title: FAQ: How has GSFC University implemented NEP 2020?
content:
Question: How has GSFC University implemented NEP 2020?
Answer: The university has adopted key NEP 2020 features: interdisciplinary learning, emphasis on practical exposure, honours and research options, and exit opportunities after three years in certain programs.

title: FAQ: Evaluation and examination system
content:
Question: Evaluation and examination system
Answer: The university follows a semester-based evaluation system with Mid-Semester Examinations (MSE), Continuous Evaluation Component (CEC), and End-Semester Examinations (ESE) for theory and practical.

title: FAQ: Medium of instruction
content:
Question: Medium of instruction
Answer: The medium of instruction at GSFC University is English.

title: FAQ: How can I apply for admission?
content:
Question: How can I apply for admission?
Answer: Applications are submitted through the 'Apply for Admission' link on the homepage of the GSFC University website.

title: FAQ: Admission process for ACPC quota and Pan-India quota
content:
Question: Admission process for ACPC quota and Pan-India quota
Answer: For ACPC admission, students appear for the GUJCET examination and apply through ACPC. For the Pan-India quota, candidates apply on the GSFC University website with a valid JEE or GUJCET score.

title: FAQ: Which entrance test scores are accepted?
content:
Question: Which entrance test scores are accepted?
Answer: For B.Tech Pan-India quota admission, GSFC University accepts a valid JEE score (the Joint Entrance Exam conducted by NTA).

title: FAQ: Admission calendar and important dates
content:
Question: Admission calendar and important dates
Answer: The key admission dates for each program are published on the GSFC University website after the respective board results are declared.

title: FAQ: Documents required at admission
content:
Question: Documents required at admission
Answer: For admission you need valid academic marksheets, entrance score (if applicable), school leaving certificate, Aadhaar card as ID proof, ABC (APAAR) ID, caste certificate (if applicable) and a passport-size photograph.

title: FAQ: Fee structure
content:
Question: Fee structure
Answer: The fee varies by program. It is published under 'Fee Structure' in the Admission menu of the website (the Fee Structure AY 2026-27 PDF). For fee questions contact accounts@gsfcuniversity.ac.in or +91-0265-3093780.

title: FAQ: Scholarships and financial aid
content:
Question: Scholarships and financial aid
Answer: The university offers Merit Scholarships for new students, Merit Scholarships for program toppers, Merit-cum-Means Scholarships, Sports Scholarships, Donor Scholarships and Need-Based Financial Assistance. It also helps students access government scholarship schemes.

title: FAQ: Earn-while-learn and assistantship opportunities
content:
Question: Earn-while-learn and assistantship opportunities
Answer: Besides internships and research opportunities, the university has an Academic Associate concept in which lower-semester students mentor their juniors, promoting peer learning.

title: FAQ: What hostel facilities are available?
content:
Question: What hostel facilities are available?
Answer: GSFC University has separate Bhavans for boys and girls. There are three: Kasturba Gandhi Bhavan (KGB) for girls, and Vikram Sarabhai Bhavan (VSB) and Swami Vivekanand Bhavan (SVB) for boys. Total capacity is 587 beds. Boys: 71 triple-occupancy rooms and 69 double-occupancy rooms. Girls: 75 triple-occupancy rooms and 2 double-occupancy rooms. Hostels are Wi-Fi enabled and have a mess.

title: FAQ: Medical facilities on campus
content:
Question: Medical facilities on campus
Answer: Students can get preliminary medical treatment at the Medical Centre of GSFC Ltd, located on the campus.

title: FAQ: Transport facilities
content:
Question: Transport facilities
Answer: Yes. Transportation is available from various locations in Vadodara city, and the campus can also be reached by public transport.

title: FAQ: Learning resources, library hours, labs and Wi-Fi
content:
Question: Learning resources, library hours, labs and Wi-Fi
Answer: The campus has a library open from 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM, advanced labs accessible 24x7, smart classrooms, and high-speed Wi-Fi across the entire campus.

title: FAQ: Incubation, innovation and startup support (GUIITAR)
content:
Question: Incubation, innovation and startup support (GUIITAR)
Answer: The GUIITAR Council (GU Incubation Innovation Technology and Applied Research) is an initiative of GSFC University established under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013. It supports innovation and entrepreneurship with shared infrastructure, advanced laboratories, co-working spaces, business support, expert mentorship and networking.

title: FAQ: Student clubs and activities
content:
Question: Student clubs and activities
Answer: The university offers 21+ active clubs and chapters covering cultural, technical, literary, social and professional domains, supporting leadership, creativity and teamwork.

title: FAQ: Sports and fitness facilities
content:
Question: Sports and fitness facilities
Answer: Indoor options: badminton courts, table tennis, chess, carrom, and a modern gymnasium with cardio, strength and free-weight equipment. Outdoor facilities: basketball, lawn tennis, volleyball courts and a kabaddi ground.

title: FAQ: NCC at GSFC University
content:
Question: NCC at GSFC University
Answer: NCC at the university is a voluntary program that builds discipline, leadership, fitness, teamwork and social responsibility. Cadets attend training and camps, do community service and can earn 'A', 'B' and 'C' certificates, which are recognized for higher education, scholarships, defence and civil service opportunities.

title: FAQ: Internship opportunities
content:
Question: Internship opportunities
Answer: Through 845+ industry partnerships, the university offers internships that give students practical training and professional connections, aligned with their academic and career goals.

title: FAQ: Industry tie-ups and collaborations
content:
Question: Industry tie-ups and collaborations
Answer: GSFC University collaborates with leading industries, institutes and organizations to strengthen education, research and skill development.

title: FAQ: Placement record and recruiters (from the FAQ document)
content:
Question: Placement record and recruiters (from the FAQ document)
Answer: The 2024 pass-out batch achieved 76% overall campus placement, and the 2025 pass-out batch had recorded 61% placement at the time of the FAQ through campus drives. Recruiters include GSFC Ltd, GNFC Ltd, Reliance Industries, Adani Group, Alembic Pharmaceuticals, Nirma, NOCIL, Torrent Pharma, Deepak Nitrite, GACL, GIPCL, Atul Ltd, TCS, Wipro, Promact Infotech, MRI Software, Odoo India, NielsenIQ, Vedanta, Tata Chemicals and Linde Group. B.Tech Fire & EHS has achieved 100% placement for three consecutive years.

title: FAQ: Alumni network
content:
Question: Alumni network
Answer: The alumni network is active through mentorship programs, guest lectures, networking events and social and professional platforms, and alumni support current students and industry-academia projects.

title: FAQ: Student exchange and study abroad
content:
Question: Student exchange and study abroad
Answer: The International Cell has partnerships with institutions in Australia, Italy, the USA and Dubai, covering joint research, academic resource sharing, faculty and short-term student exchange, and international internships.

title: FAQ: NAAC, NBA and NIRF accreditation status
content:
Question: NAAC, NBA and NIRF accreditation status
Answer: The university has a fully functional Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) and is preparing to align with the new NAAC accreditation framework once it is issued. The website has pages for IQAC, NIRF and AISHE.
